name: Voortman Fabricator
summary: Robotic fitting and welding cell for structural steel shops: a welding robot places plates and parts on beams and profiles up to 24 m, aligns them by hole positions and laser scanning, and welds them, driven straight from the Tekla/SDS2 model.

germany.statusNote: Dutch maker with a German office in Langenfeld and a German product page; sold on request through Voortman ("Get in touch", quote form). No public price.

sellers.name: Voortman (German office)
sellers.note: Siemensstraße 6, 40764 Langenfeld, Germany (contact page). Head office: Ozonstraat 17, 7463 PK Rijssen, Netherlands, +31 548 536 373.

specs.label: Profile length
specs.quote: The Fabricator handles profile lengths up to 24 m (80 ft) and heavy components with ease

specs.label: Profiles
specs.value: angles, box, I/H, T-sections and channels
specs.quote: the machine delivers consistent, high quality robotic welds across all profiles (angles, box, I/H, T-sections and channels)

specs.label: Part alignment
specs.quote: Parts are automatically aligned using hole-based positioning and laser scanning.

specs.label: Software
specs.value: VACAM CNC control and LogicSteel CADCAM; needs Tekla or SDS2 models
specs.quote: The Fabricator comes with both VACAM CNC control and LogicSteel CADCAM software.

specs.label: Working zones
specs.value: single or multiple zones; load and scan in one zone while the robot welds in another
specs.quote: With multiple zones, operators can load, unload, and scan profiles in one zone while the welding robot continues processing in another.

notes: Fixed robot cell in the steel shop (no mobile base): one robot fits parts and welds; switches between fit-only and fit + weld.
Profiles are loaded by the operator; the maker says it runs without operator intervention and detects and corrects deviations.
Needs Tekla or SDS2 detailing models; optional metal-coated wire upgrade removes the need to shotblast first.
